bio: This inconspicuous-looking restaurant is a stone's throw from the Hofgarten public park. Chef Daniel Baur and Olga Jorich have plenty of regulars here, and with good reason. The fresh, flavoursome dishes are carefully crafted using quality ingredients and represent excellent value for money. The veal rissoles are well worth trying. Neither will you be disappointed by the wine list! Olga Jorich's friendly and thoughtful approach to running the service plays a key role in creating the inviting atmosphere. Charming sheltered terrace to the rear of the building....
